tools.name: nl_vehicle_basic
tools.description: Free. Use when the user gives a Dutch licence plate or asks about a specific car in the Netherlands: make, model, age, fuel, Euro class, APK (MOT) expiry, insurance, open recall, RDW odometer verdict and a risk level. Source: RDW.

tools.name: nl_car_model
tools.description: Free. Use when the user asks how reliable a car model is, or which used car to buy: facts for the model in the Netherlands from RDW data: APK (MOT) defect rate vs the average of all models, the 10 most common APK defects, recalls with component and risk, share with an open recall, share with an illo

tools.name: buy_full_vehicle_report
tools.description: Returns a secure payment link (iDEAL or card, via Dodo Payments, EUR 1.95 incl. VAT) for the full English vehicle report: APK inspection history with defects, recall details, import/taxi/export history, specs and catalogue price. Only use when the user wants the full report or asks to buy it.
